definition.def: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.
examples: Patriotic songs have long been a feature of Kuwaiti life. [+ of]
The spacious gardens are a special feature of this property. [+ of]
Perhaps the most unusual feature in the room is an extraordinary pair of candles.

definition.def: Your features are your eyes, nose, mouth, and other parts of your face.
When something such as a film or exhibition features a particular person or thing, they are an important part of it.
examples: It's a great movie and it features a Spanish actor who is going to be a world star within a year. [VERB noun]
The hour-long programme will be updated each week and feature highlights from recent games. [VERB noun]
This spectacular event, now in its 5th year, features a stunning catwalk show. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If someone or something features in something such as a show, exhibition, or magazine, they are an important part of it.
examples: Jon featured in one of the show's most thrilling episodes. [V + in/on]

definition.def: A feature is a special article in a newspaper or magazine, or a special programme on radio or television.
examples: We are delighted to see the Sunday Times running a long feature on breast cancer.
...a special feature on the fund-raising project. [+ on]

definition.def: A feature or a feature film or movie is a full-length film about a fictional situation, as opposed to a short film or a documentary.
examples: ...the first feature-length cartoon, Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.

definition.def: A geographical feature is something noticeable in a particular area of country, for example a hill, river, or valley.

examples.sentence: In Europe a recent feature of corporate life in the recession has been the delayering of management structures.
